verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy, but Buzz can be self-hosted. The relay runs on your own infrastructure ("that place is yours", "No external services required"), and the agent runtime can use local or self-hosted model backends such as Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp. That means a user can keep conversation data away from third-party model providers by architecture rather than by policy. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor or hosted-operator commitment that data is not used for AI training, a documented training opt-out control, guarantees covering operator-hosted shared instances, and any independent corroboration.
